description: Use for 'what do the tracked 13F filers hold most widely?' (takes no ticker). Returns {as_of_quarter, tickers_found, min_funds, consensus}; each row is {ticker, issuer_name, fund_count, total_value_usd, total_shares, funds}, ranked by fund_count then value. `consensus` is truncated to top_n (default 10, cap 200) and each row's `funds` to funds_per_ticker (default 5, cap 25); `tickers_found` is the FULL count meeting min_funds (default 2, cap 20). COMMON STOCK ONLY: an ownership tally, not exposure. Each fund contributes its own latest quarter. For one ticker's buyers: ol_ownership_changes. Source: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR, ~45-day quarterly delay.

funds_per_ticker.description: Fund rows listed under each ticker, by value (default 5, max 25).

min_funds.description: Minimum number of notable funds that must hold a ticker for it to appear (default 2, max 20).

top_n.description: Maximum number of consensus tickers to return (default 10, max 200).

name: get_institutional_consensus
title: Most Widely Held (13F)
